stories.title: Buddy Blog--Gator Football: Where Does It Go From Here? I'm Glad You Asked!
stories.author: Buddy Martin
stories.excerpt:
But make no mistake: What happened in Columbia was worse than a speed bump. It was a public mugging. It was a betrayal of sorts.
The question is: Who betrayed whom?

stories.title: The loss to Mizzou is history; the question is how will the Gators respond?
stories.author: Franz Beard
stories.excerpt: For an entire month Jon Sumrall had been warning that the Florida Gators would be exposed somewhere down the road if they didn’t change their ways. Somewhere down the road was Columbia, Missouri, where Saturday afternoon the 8th-ranked Gators (4-1, 2-1 SEC) took one of those leave no place on their body without a bruise beatings at the hands of the 25th-ranked Missouri Tigers (4-1, 1-1 SEC).     Just a couple of days prior to this 45-17 mauling at Memorial Stadium one revised forecast after...

stories.title: Hey Missouri, Don’t Show Me Anymore!
stories.author: Buddy Martin
stories.excerpt: The Tigers did not just beat Florida. They drove over it, backed up, drove over it again and then threw a couple touchdown passes just to make sure nobody mistook the afternoon for a competitive football game.

stories.title: Week 5 Preview: Florida Gators (4-0, 2-0) v. Missouri Tigers (3-1, 0-1)
stories.author: Loren Meadows
stories.excerpt: A trip to Columbia can be tough but the Gators are equipped to travel and travel well.

stories.title: The Wizards Have Spoken, And These Florida Gators Are Suddenly Somebody
stories.author: Buddy Martin
stories.excerpt: Hey! No resting on your laurels, Scott Stricklin By Buddy Martin GatorBaitMedia.com Somewhere in Gainesville there’s a whistle with teeth marks in it. It belongs to Jon Sumrall, and it’s the only thing in Florida football that has taken a beating lately. Think back to where we were a month ago. If you’d said in August that the Gators would go into the first weekend of October ranked No. 8, with the ESPN wizards giving them a 61 percent chance of making the College Football Playoff if they win...

stories.title: Denzel Aberdeen is back home where he belongs
stories.author: Franz Beard
stories.excerpt: A judge cleared Denzel Aberdeen for a fifth year, and the guard who left after Florida's 2025 title is back in Gainesville chasing another championship and his degree.

stories.title: The Soothsayer: Gators head to Missouri, where history hasn’t been kind
stories.author: Franz Beard
stories.excerpt: Florida (4-0) heads to Columbia, where history has not been kind, with a No. 8 ranking and a 5.5-point cushion. The Soothsayer on Missouri, Saturday’s SEC slate and the coaching hot seat.
